The '''Waldo Flats''' were a flat rock formation on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Waldo Grade/Legends|Waldo Grade]], a curving canyon that cut through the Waldo Flats, was part of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] course.
